meta.name: captain-log
meta.description: Append to or read the captain's narrative log — decisions, friction, learning, milestones, observations, builds.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录项目中的关键事件与思考
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发或工作中记录决策与收获
copy.tagline_en: Log key events and reflections from your projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep a narrative of decisions and learnings

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以记录或阅读会话的叙事日志。日志涵盖决策、摩擦、学习、里程碑、观察、构建等类别，每天一个文件，追加只写。也可读取当天或指定日期日志，列出所有日志文件，或显示当天日志路径。
howto.when: 当你说“记录”并描述具体事件（如决策、摩擦等）时触发写操作；当你说“读取日志”、“读取某天日志”、“列出日志”或“日志路径”时触发读操作。

say.text: 记录一个决策：我们决定用 PostgreSQL。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can append to or read the captain's narrative log. Log entries cover decisions, friction, learning, milestones, observations, and builds, stored daily in append-only files. It can also read today's or a specific day's log, list all log files, or print today's path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "log" with details about an event (e.g., decision, friction) for writes; or when you ask to "read log", "read log for date", "list logs", or "log path" for reads.

say_en.text: Log a decision: we chose PostgreSQL.
